name: Hemet Nesingwary
summary: A crate delayed on the road from Kalimdor reaches the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale by sea. At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard sends special supplies to Hemet Nesingwary, the renowned big-game hunter.

sections.title: A Transcontinental Delivery
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, Kravel Koalbeard receives a long-overdue crate for one of his wealthy patrons. Hemet Nesingwary had already left Thousand Needles, but he paid to have the crate sent on to his hunting camp in Stranglethorn Vale. Kravel stays behind rather than face the arduous journey himself. So he hires passing adventurers to carry the crate across the sea.

sections.title: Ammunition for the Hunt
sections.body: North of Grom'gol Base Camp, Hemet Nesingwary's expedition receives the heavy crate. It holds specialized heavy-gauge ammunition for bringing down the jungle's dangerous predators. Hemet recognizes the white salt crust on the courier's gear. His old dealings with Kravel have brought the firepower his safari needed.

faq.q: Where does this delivery begin and end?
faq.answer: The delivery starts with Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, in southern Thousand Needles. It ends at Hemet Nesingwary's expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, just north of Grom'gol.
Kravel's crate holds special-gauge ammunition for big-game firearms. Hemet ordered the shot to pierce the thick hides of Stranglethorn's fiercest beasts.

faq.q: Why didn't Kravel deliver the crate himself?
faq.answer: Kravel stays busy overseeing his investments and schemes at the Mirage Raceway. He uses the coin Hemet paid in advance to hire passing adventurers rather than leave his post to cross the sea.

faq.q: How does Hemet know where the courier came from?
faq.answer: Hemet recognizes the salt crust on the courier's garments as a mark of the Shimmering Flats, not ordinary desert dust.

faq.q: What kind of relationship do Kravel and Hemet have?
faq.answer: Hemet is an old and lucrative customer of Kravel's. Kravel respects Hemet's deep pockets, while Hemet fondly calls Kravel a 'crusty old' rogue who's perpetually up to no good.
Hemet Nesingwary is a celebrated dwarven marksman, author, and big-game hunter. He leads a safari through the perilous depths of Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a hunter, you carry specialized ammunition to Hemet Nesingwary, who leads Azeroth's most famous big-game safari.
As a dwarf, you see two roguish dwarven acquaintances scattered from Ironforge in pursuit of coin and quarry.
